## Payment Clause (PC)

Extends the shared Clause additively with the numbers finance scans for: Net-N days, monthly late-fee rate, early-payment discount and window, accepted methods. Instances set `clauseType` to `payment`.

### Non-goals

No invoice integration — the clause states terms; Invoice enforces its own due dates.
